steps.say: A breakout means more when the structure is already rising, | and when a crowd turns up for it.
Add three single signals: market structure, Bollinger position, and the heavy-volume candle.
Line one: market structure is up. | Line two: the close is at or above the upper Bollinger band. | Line three: today's volume is at least twice the usual.
Save it, and run it on your equities.
Yes means all three are true on today's finished candle. | Each No shows which piece is missing.
